mapper.sql: select record_id, assist_id, follow_type, follow_content, follow_time, operator_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time from sam_warning_assist_record
mapper.insert: insert into sam_warning_assist_record (assist_id, follow_type, follow_content, follow_time, operator_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time) values (#{assistId}, #{followType}, #{followContent}, #{followTime}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where assist_id = #{assistId} order by follow_time desc, record_id desc
mapper.delete: delete from sam_warning_assist_record where assist_id in #{assistId}
